headline: Iran to reopen Hormuz, US to lift blockade after deal, Pakistan PM says
summary: The memorandum of understanding, aimed at ending the Middle East war, will see Iran instantly reopen the Strait of Hormuz and the US immediately lift its naval blockade. Pakistan will host a ceremony in Switzerland to commemorate the event.
details: A memorandum of understanding (MoU) between the US and Iran has been signed to end the Middle East war, Pakistan's Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif announced on Thursday. This landmark agreement signifies a major diplomatic breakthrough in the region.

According to Sharif, the MoU dictates that Iran will "instantly" reopen the Strait of Hormuz, a crucial global shipping lane. Concurrently, the United States will "immediately" lift its naval blockade on Iranian ports, easing economic pressures.
Sharif confirmed these details in a post on X, stating that the memorandum "shall enter into force with immediate effect." This swift implementation aims to de-escalate tensions and foster stability.

Pakistan, with support from Qatar, is set to host a ceremony in Switzerland on Friday. This event will commemorate the agreement and initiate technical-level talks between the parties, marking the next phase of the peace process.

headline: Storm with 60 km/h winds expected in 13 regions including Dhaka by 9 AM today
summary: A storm with winds up to 60 km/h is forecast for 13 regions across Bangladesh, including the capital Dhaka. Residents are advised to stay alert for potential adverse weather conditions.
details: A storm with wind speeds of up to 60 kilometers per hour is anticipated to hit 13 regions across Bangladesh, including the capital city Dhaka. The Bangladesh Meteorological Department has issued a warning for these areas, urging residents to prepare for potential impacts.
The forecast indicates that these stormy conditions are expected to develop by 9 AM today. Authorities are monitoring the situation closely and will provide updates as necessary.
